risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, reporting changes in orders, margins, costs, cash flows, debt repayments, and share repurchases. It acknowledges material exposure to mortgage rates, affordability, labor and material costs, supply-chain constraints, production delays, and seasonal working-capital needs, but maintains a notably optimistic tone regarding demand and liquidity. Some forward-looking assurances and broad mitigating statements provide limited detail on downside sensitivity and future stress scenarios.
